answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 27846 Country: India Title: I am a salaried person and a substantial amount from my salary is deducted as taxes. I have two questions: 1. At the time of calculating Zakat should I consider my gross salary i.e. before deductions or the net in hand after deductions. 2. In order to avail tax exemption can I take a housing loan as that will not only save my halal earnings but also be helpful in owning an asset. Please guide. Question: Assalamualaikum, Janab I am a salaried person and a substantial amount from my salary is deducted as taxes. I have two questions: 1. At the time of calculating Zakat should I consider my gross salary i.e. before deductions or the net in hand after deductions. 2. In order to avail tax exemption can I take a housing loan as that will not only save my halal earnings but also be helpful in owning an asset. Please guide.. Jazak Allah Answer ID: 27846 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2140/B=1740/tb=1431) (1) As much salary you receive (after deduction), only that much will be taken into consideration. (2) It is permissible to avail housing loan in order to save one's hard-earned income from un-Islamic taxation. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
